result.summary: Found one layout issue where text elements in the 'Popular right now' section are overlapping.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section (Tokumaru Ramen Bar), the delivery time '25-30' is overlapping with the word 'delivery' and the category 'Ramen', creating a collision and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container width, adjust font sizing, or implement dynamic spacing to ensure the time, delivery status, and category text do not overlap.
